bounds: SentenceBoundary
Before you press the final button, confirm the company, security, amount, fees, and payment method.
SentenceBoundary
In a Reg CF offering, submitting an investment generally creates a commitment, but federal rules provide a limited cancellation window.
SentenceBoundary
You may cancel for any reason until forty-eight hours before the offering’s deadline.
SentenceBoundary
During the final forty-eight hours, you generally cannot cancel for any reason, even if you committed within that period.
SentenceBoundary
If the company makes a material change to the offering, investors must be given five business days to reconfirm.
SentenceBoundary
The exact platform steps and notices matter, so read the confirmation and official disclosures.
SentenceBoundary
These rules apply to Reg CF and should not be assumed for every private investment.
SentenceBoundary
A commitment is not a casual “save for later” click.
SentenceBoundary
If you are uncertain, review the terms before committing rather than relying on a later cancellation.
SentenceBoundary
Keep a copy of the confirmation and any cancellation or reconfirmation notice.
